Let me select O (red4) and swap with Y (green3): red=[R,p,hook,Y], green=[b,N,O,M]. See if the hook moves.

That was my original hypothesis. But when I selected Y... wait, Y can't be selected. I clicked Y, then clicked the hook — but Y wasn't selected (no flash). Let me test: select O (red4, flash), then click Y (green3). If the hook goes to green3 and Y goes to red3: red=[R,p,Y,O], green=[b,N,hook,M].
